Hi Marissa (and Dev),

Thanks again for the call this morning — good to meet you both. Quick recap and the asks we have on our side so we can align on pricing: 

1) Estimated monthly token volumes (rough):
   - Chat / convo generation: ~3,000,000,000 tokens (3B)
   - Embeddings (semantic search + vector updates): ~1,500,000,000 tokens (1.5B)
   - Rerank / scoring: ~500,000,000 tokens (0.5B)
   - Total: ~5B tokens / month

2) Model mix: interested in a combination of a chat-focused model for UI (similar to open-chat-large), an embeddings model for search, and a rerank model for high-precision results.

3) Budget range: our finance partner asked for a target unit economics number to evaluate: target $/1M tokens and an estimated monthly spend range. For initial planning they suggested we aim for something <= $1,200 per 1M tokens across our mix, but open to your guidance on feasible targets given different model choices.

4) Next steps we need from Redwood:
   - Per-model unit price / $ per 1M tokens for chat, embeddings, and rerank at our volume band (5B/mo).
   - Any recommended model/quantization mixes to hit cost targets and preserve quality.
   - Example contract terms for a Dedicated/reserved capacity option (commit level and uplift for SLAs).

I've attached a simple spreadsheet with month-by-month estimates we use internally — has the detailed breakdown by product. Procurement is looped (procurement@chatly.com).

Appreciate a short summary and suggested next meeting time to review pricing and any potential pilot.

Best,
Sophie

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: dev.patel@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery call recap + pricing follow-up

Hi Sophie — thanks for the clear recap and for sharing the spreadsheet. Appreciate the budget context; that makes prioritization easier. Below is a concise pricing/volume qualification and our initial recommendation so your finance/procurement team has concrete numbers to work with.

Short answers up front:
- At ~5B tokens/mo split (chat 60% / embeddings 30% / rerank 10%), a realistic target across the mix to aim for is $800–$1,200 per 1M tokens depending on model choices and whether you take Dedicated reserved capacity.
- We can get to the lower end (~$800/1M) with a mix that uses a quantized chat model for most traffic + high-throughput embeddings and rerank on optimized instances. Dedicated commits will also materially reduce unit price.

Per-model (illustrative) unit economics at 5B tokens/mo (list price estimates; final pricing will be in the contract):
- chat (open-chat-large / quantized variant): $1,100 per 1M tokens (at on-demand hosted rates) — with Dedicated reserved commit we can discount to ~$750–$900 per 1M depending on commit term and level.
- embeddings (embed-large-v2): $300 per 1M vectors/tokens equivalent (embeddings are typically lower cost per unit but count differently; we convert to token-equivalent in your sheet).
- rerank (rerank-alpha): $1,400 per 1M tokens for high-precision rerank calls (but note rerank calls tend to be shorter; the 0.5B estimate already factors in smaller prompt sizes).

Example blended math using your volumes (chat 3B, embed 1.5B, rerank 0.5B) at list estimates:
- Chat: 3,000M tokens * $1,100 / 1,000M = $3,300
- Embeddings: 1,500M * $300 / 1,000M = $450
- Rerank: 500M * $1,400 / 1,000M = $700
- Blended monthly cost (per 1M token units converted): ~$4,450 -> this is a blended absolute $ number; dividing by total 5,000M tokens gives ~$890 per 1M tokens blended.

Notes / recommendations:
- If we move to a Dedicated reserved capacity commit (recommended for predictability), we typically see 20–35% off these list estimates at your scale (example: chat could drop to ~$750–$880/1M, embeddings to ~$210–$240/1M, rerank to ~$900–$1,100/1M depending on capacity sizing and reserved GPU type).
- We can provide a model-mix recommendation that trades small output-quality delta for larger unit cost savings (e.g., routing lower-latency, high-volume chat to a quantized variant and reserving highest-quality chat for ~10–20% of traffic).
- Operational levers: batching, prefix caching, and KV cache affinity will reduce effective per-token costs for chat-heavy workloads — we can quantify after a short pilot with sample prompts.

Attached is a one-pager with the numbers above + a sample Dedicated commit tiers matrix for your review. If useful I can also prepare a version that shows two blended scenarios: (A) Hosted with moderate discounts, (B) Dedicated 12-month commit.

Proposed next steps:
- I’ll sync with Dev (cc'd) to confirm any technical constraints for embeddings sizing and rerank prompt lengths so we can finalize per-call unit equivalency.
- If procurement is ready, share a target commit range (monthly reserved tokens or $ commit) and we’ll draft a preliminary commercial term sheet.
- Suggested call: Thu 30 Jun 10:00–10:30 PT to review the two blended scenarios and Q&A. If that works I’ll send a calendar invite.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
